description: This file defines the CandidateHistoryDecorator class, which provides methods to modify and retrieve information related to CandidateHistory entities within an HR management system. It includes methods for associating candidates, vacancies, interviews, and employees with a candidate history record, as well as formatting date fields and obtaining descriptive action strings.

classes.name: CandidateHistoryDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for managing CandidateHistory entities, providing methods to set related entities and format action or date representations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a CandidateHistory entity.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with the CandidateHistory record by candidate ID.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy entity with the CandidateHistory record by vacancy ID.

methods.name: setInterviewByInterviewId
methods.description: Associates an Interview entity with the CandidateHistory record by interview ID.

methods.name: setPerformedBy
methods.description: Associates an Employee (who performed the action) with the CandidateHistory record by employee ID.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryAction
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly string representing the action taken in this candidate history record, based on an internal action ID and mapping arrays.

methods.name: getPerformedDate
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the date when the action was performed.
